parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description: The accelerated domain name. Separate multiple accelerated domain names with commas (,).

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description:
The end of the time range to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

>  The end time must be later than the start time.

parameters.name: IspNameEn
parameters.description:
The name of the Internet service provider (ISP).

If you do not set this parameter, all ISPs are queried. You can call [DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp](~~DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp~~) to query ISP names.

parameters.name: LocationNameEn
parameters.description:
The name of the region.

If you do not set this parameter, all regions are queried. You can call [DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp](~~DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp~~) to query regions.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description:
The beginning of the time range to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dcdn describe-dcdn-domain-real-time-bps-data --domain-name example.com --isp-name-en telecom --location-name-en beijing --start-time 2018-01-02T11:00:00Z --end-time 2018-01-02T11:00:00Z --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dcdn DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeBpsData --region cn-hangzhou --IspNameEn telecom --EndTime '2018-01-02T11:00:00Z' --DomainName 'example.com' --LocationNameEn beijing --StartTime '2018-01-02T11:00:00Z'
